We have many templates. For amide formation, template 647549 seems to be O-CO-aryl + NH2-aryl -> amide (reverse). That is suitable: It shows O-[C](=O)-aryl + NH2-aryl -> amide. So we can use template_id 647549.

For SN2, template 6195 is Cl-aryl + amine -> aryl-amine. That matches step2.

For Friedel-Crafts acylation, we need a template that forms C-C bond via acyl chloride to aromatic ring. Look for template where Cl-aryl + acyl chloride -> acylated aromatic. Search for functional_groups_broken: "acyl chloride", "aryl halide". Let's search.
<thought>Search for templates that break an acyl chloride and an aryl halide, forming a carbonyl attached to aromatic (Friedel-Crafts acylation).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride", "aryl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>

Let's see result.
